name: Colorado River (Westwater Canyon)
gaugeName: Colorado River near Colorado-Utah state line
blurb: Westwater Canyon: 17 miles of Class IV whitewater just inside Utah. BLM permit required year-round; launches only from the Westwater Ranger Station.

sections.notes: BLM: 17 miles, Class IV, challenging at all water levels, experienced boaters only; permit required year-round (recreation.gov).

putInAccess.operator: Bureau of Land Management (Moab Field Office)
putInAccess.sourceName: BLM National Recreation Site Points, OBJECTID 69678 'Westwater Ranger Station' (Boat Ramp, UTY01000)
putInAccess.note: BLM National Recreation Site Points, OBJECTID 69678 'Westwater Ranger Station' (Boat Ramp, UTY01000) is the managing agency's own point. Legal boating access: BLM Moab FO: Westwater Canyon River Permits (https://www.blm.gov/visit/westwater-canyon-river-permits): Directions: 'Westwater Ranger Station (the put-in): From Interstate 70, take exit 227.' Page Geographic Coordinates 39.08638, -109.10142. 'The canyon is 17 miles long and includes Class IV rapids'; permit required. Imagery: Esri World Imagery z19 checked 2026-10-25 (research/raw/imagery/westwater_ranger_station_boat_ramp.png): the point is on the bank just upstream of the ramp structures beside the ranger station; the BLM page coordinate is about 20 m south on the same launch. NHD flowline 81 m away.
putInAccess.bankSourceName: USGS NHD High Resolution flowline (flow-direction digitized) + Esri World Imagery
putInAccess.bankNote: Facing downstream (flow bearing ~152), the point is right of the NHD centreline (81 m).

takeOutAccess.operator: Bureau of Land Management (Moab Field Office)

takeOutAccess.note: BLM Moab FO Cisco Takeout page, 'Geographic Coordinates 38.970407, -109.2506984' (the BLM GIS point OBJECTID 67918 at 38.970099, -109.252391 sits ~150 m west on the access road loop, so the page coordinate, which imagery puts at the head of the concrete ramp, is used) is the managing agency's own point. Legal boating access: BLM Moab FO: Cisco Takeout (https://www.blm.gov/visit/cisco-takeout): 'Terminus for Westwater boat trip'; Geographic Coordinates 38.970407, -109.2506984; BLM boat ramp feature. Imagery: Esri World Imagery z19 checked 2026-10-25 (research/raw/imagery/cisco_takeout.png): the BLM page coordinate is at the head of the concrete ramp, about 30-35 m from the water. The older BLM GIS point (OBJECTID 67918) was about 150 m west on the access loop and was not used (research/raw/imagery/cisco_takeout_gis_point_old.png). NHD flowline 111 m away.
